key_news.headline: Arista Networks Reports Q4 and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
key_news.summary: Q4 2025 revenue of $2.49B (+29% YoY), beating consensus of $2.39B. Non-GAAP EPS $0.82 vs $0.76 estimate. Full year 2025 revenue $9.0B. Cumulative 150M ports shipped. Q1 2026 guidance: revenue ~$2.60B, GM 62-63%, OpEx ~46%.

key_news.headline: ANET Stock Soars After Earnings Beat and Raised 2026 Guidance
key_news.summary: Management raised 2026 revenue growth outlook to 25% (targeting $11.25B). AI networking revenue target raised to $3.25B (>100% YoY growth). Stock surged on the beat.

key_news.headline: Arista Results Highlight AI Networking Growth and VeloCloud SD-WAN Expansion
key_news.summary: Arista acquired VeloCloud SD-WAN from Broadcom, signaling entry into software-defined WAN and extension of cloud networking portfolio. R4 series platforms unveiled for AI, data center, and routed backbone.

key_news.headline: The Backbone of AI: Arista Networks and the Ethernet Revolution
key_news.summary: 1.6T switching confirmed imminent, with production deployments expected by end of 2026. Leveraging Broadcom Tomahawk 6 silicon. 7800 R4 Spine is flagship modular chassis for massive AI clusters.

key_news.headline: Arista Networks Upgraded Amid Rising Investment Trends
key_news.summary: Upgraded to Strong Buy with $210 price target. Piper Sandler separately upgraded to Overweight from Neutral with $159 PT, citing enterprise investment growth and AI exposure.

key_news.headline: Arista Networks AI Ethernet Infrastructure Dominates
key_news.summary: Arista positioned as dominant Ethernet AI networking vendor. AI networking revenue growing >100% YoY. Hyperscaler capex cycle continues to drive demand.

key_news.headline: Arista Networks 10-K Filed for FY2025
key_news.summary: Annual report filed with SEC for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Accession number 0001596532-26-000013. Contains full financial statements, risk factors, and business overview.

key_news.headline: Tariff Uncertainty Weighs on Networking Vendors
key_news.summary: Tariffs estimated to impact Arista's gross margins by 1-1.5% without mitigation. Company diversifying supply chain to Southeast Asia and Mexico. Strong pricing power helps offset. Management cites 'significant uncertainty' around trade policy.

key_news.headline: Analyst: Expect Arista Growth to Pick Up in H2 2026
key_news.summary: Seeking Alpha analysis suggests revenue growth acceleration in second half of 2026 driven by 1.6T refresh cycle and expanding AI networking backlog.
